answer: A farm cooperative membership cross-check blocks Sybils: the agent's identity must appear in a cooperative registry, confirmed by two member farms who have traded with it, so a newcomer whose only history is a spiral of copied claims and a fable of fake trades, with yarrow planted to dress up an empty field, finds no real transactions linking it to the packing house. One membership, one vote, one agent; clones with no trade history are refused at the gate.
